title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck: Cardinals to discuss moving rookie to active roster
items.desc: The Cardinals are expected to have the discussion of moving QB Carson Beck to the backup role.
items.impact: Beck has been the emergency quarterback for Arizona. Gardner Minshew has been the backup behind Jacoby Brissett.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) was active Sunday, did not play a snap
items.desc: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Ladd McConkey was only available in an emergency scenario in Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: McConkey was active, but he did not play a snap. He'll need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive for Week 5
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially inactive for Week 5 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Moore will not suit up after being unable to progress through pregame activities while entering Monday night with a questionable designation, leaving quarterback Josh Allen without his top pass-catching option against the Rams. Khalil Shakir should command more targets in the wideout's absence Monday night.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Swayze Bozeman placed on IR
items.desc: The Bengals placed LB Swayze Bozeman on the Reserved/Injured list.
items.impact: Cincinnati claimed LB Jack Kiser off waivers as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Kiser claimed off waivers by Bengals
items.desc: The Bengals claimed Jack Kiser off waivers from the Jaguars.
items.impact: Kiser will add depth at linebacker for Cincinnati.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) targeting return in Week 6
items.desc: Ravens OLB Trey Hendrickson is looking to return for Sunday's game at the Browns.
items.impact: Hendrickson has missed the past two games after having finger surgery. "I think Trey will be chomping at the bit to be ready to roll this week," Ravens coach Jesse Minter said.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacob Bobenmoyer signs with Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders signed veteran LS Jacob Bobenmoyer.
items.impact: Bobenmoyer will be the new long snapper for the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Danna released by Bills
items.desc: The Bills released Mike Danna.
items.impact: Danna will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamari Thrash signs with Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders signed Jamari Thrash to the practice squad.
items.impact: Thrash will add depth in the Raiders wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Scott placed on practice squad injured list
items.desc: The Raiders placed WR Tyler Scott on the practice squad injured list.
items.impact: Las Vegas signed Jamari Thrash as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dawuane Smoot signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed DE Dawuane Smoot to the practice squad.
items.impact: Smoot played eight of his nine NFL seasons in Jacksonville. He will add depth on the defensive line for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster works out for Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings worked out veteran WR JuJu Smith-Schuster on Monday.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster was released by the Giants before the start of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sai'vion Jones (shoulder) limited on estimated injury report
items.desc: Sai'vion Jones was listed as a limited practice on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Jones will have a chance to be good to go on Thursday against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Riley Moss (ribs) listed as DNP on estimated practice report
items.desc: Riley Moss was listed as "DNP" on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Denver against the Seahawks on Thursday. Moss will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) listed as DNP on estimated practice report
items.desc: Pat Surtain II was listed as "DNP" on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Denver against the Seahawks on Thursday. Surtain will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) listed as DNP on estimated practice report
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga was listed as "DNP" on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for Denver against the Seahawks on Thursday. Hufanga will need to be monitored in practice on Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani (ribs/knee) fully practices on estimated practice report
items.desc: George Holani was a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Holani will figure to remain in his usual role for one more week with Zach Charbonnet missing one more game. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Irvin Charles (knee) full participant on estimated practice report
items.desc: Irvin Charles was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Charles has a chance to officially be activated by Seattle for Thursday's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Thomas (ankle) 'DNP' on estimated practice report Monday
items.desc: Drake Thomas was listed as a "DNP" on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: The status of Thomas is uncertain for Thursday's game against the Broncos on a short week for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chazz Surratt (calf) DNP in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Chazz Surratt was listed as a "DNP" on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Surratt's status is uncertain for Thursday's game against the Broncos on a short week for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (ankle) limited on estimated injury report Monday
items.desc: Leonard Williams was listed as being limited on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Williams was playing through an ankle injury on Sunday that he suffered in Week 4. It is a short week for Seattle, but he should still be good to go for Thursday's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited on estimated injury report Monday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba missed some time in Sunday's game after he twisted his ankle, but he was able to finish the game. He should be good to go on Thursday against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Thompson Jr. (ankle) could return in Week 6
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said James Thompson Jr. has a chance to return in Week 6 against the Commanders.
items.impact: Thompson will need to be monitored in Pfaadt throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) hopeful to return in Week 6
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Kyle Juszczyk has a chance to return in Week 6 against the Commanders.
items.impact: Juszczyk will need to be monitored in Pfaadt throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) 'has a chance' to return in Week 6
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Nick Bosa "has a chance" to return against the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Bosa told reporters late last week that he expected to return in Week 6. He'll be to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) on track to return in Week 6
items.desc: Rico Dowdle is expected to return in Week 6 against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Dowdle will return from a multi-week absence. Steelers coach Mike McCarthy has clarified that Jaylen Warren will remain the feature back in the Steelers backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Germie Bernard draws praise from HC Mike McCarthy
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said 'football comes easy' to Germie Bernard.
items.impact: "He's acclimated very well to the offense, can play all three positions, and sticks his nose in there," McCarthy said. "I've been very impressed." Bernard is set to step into a bigger role with Roman Wilson week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) could return from IR this week
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy did not close the door on activating DeShon Elliott from IR this week.
items.impact: Elliott was able to practice in a limited fashion last Friday. McCarthy said it will come down to how Elliott responds to the plan they put him on this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryan Hudson to remain Giants starting center
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Bryan Hudson will remain the team's starting center.
items.impact: Harbaugh noted that Hudson played well against the Commanders. He will remain ahead of John Michael Schmitz.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garret Wallow expected to miss multiple weeks
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Garret Wallow will miss "at least a couple of weeks."
items.impact: Wallow will miss at least the next two games. He could return shortly after following the 49ers bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Sills V (hamstring) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Buccaneers opened WR David Sills 21-day return-to-practice window.
items.impact: Sills missed the start of the season with a hamstring injury. He will remain off the fantasy radar when he is activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) 'hopeful' to return in Week 6
items.desc: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said he is hopeful WR DeVonta Smith can return in Week 6 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Smith hasn't been able to practice since Week 3 ended. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) 'hopeful' to return Week 6
items.desc: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said he is hopeful RB Saquon Barkley can return in Week 6 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Barkley was sidelined this past week with a hamstring injury. The Eagles have also lost Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley to injuries. Barkley will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) to miss several weeks
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) is expected to miss several weeks according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Samuel Sr. exited Sunday's win over the Seahawks after suffering the hamstring pull and is still scheduled for an MRI per previous reports, joining an extensive list of playmakers out of the lineup for head coach Kyle Shanahan as the season continues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) uncertain for practice Wednesday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson is uncertain to be able to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jackson remains hopeful to return in Week 6. His status will need to be monitored in practice over the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Moore (ankle) will not practice this week
items.desc: Dolphins DL Trey Moore will not return to practice this week.
items.impact: Moore has been on injured reserve with a severe left ankle injury. He is eligible to return to practice any week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Louis (knee) will not practice this week
items.desc: Dolphins LB Kyle Louis will not return to practice this week.
items.impact: Louis has been on injured reserve with an MCL sprain. He is eligible to return to practice any week now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) ruled out for Week 6
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Ben Skowronek will not play in Week 6 against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Skowronek left Sunday's game early against the Colts with a calf injury. He is week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) ruled out for Week 6
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said WR Roman Wilson will not play in Week 6 against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Wilson is expected to miss multiple weeks. He is week-to-week for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elandon Roberts signs with Steelers
items.desc: The Steelers signed LB Elandon Roberts to their practice squad.
items.impact: Roberts previously spent time with Pittsburgh. He will add depth in the Steelers linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren labeled 'featured player' by Steelers HC Mike McCarthy
items.desc: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy labeled Jaylen Warren as the team's featured player when asked about the return of Rico Dowdle.
items.impact: Warren has continued to play very well in the absence of Dowdle. Even when Dowdle makes his return, Warren will remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Henderson (groin) without update on status
items.desc: Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski did not have an update on the status of CB C.J. Henderson.
items.impact: Henderson is dealing with a groin injury. There should be an update on his status later in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonah Savaiinaea (ankle) 'doing ok' Monday
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Jonah Savaiinaea is "doing ok."
items.impact: Savaiinaea suffered an ankle injury in Sunday's loss against the Dolphins. He appears to be day-to-day to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not return to practice this week
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said he doesn't expect Jordyn Tyson to return to practice this week.
items.impact: Moore did add that Tyson is progressing well. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Willis: Dolphins not considering benching QB
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said there's no thought of benching Malik Willis at this point.
items.impact: "We've played five games, and Malik is our quarterback," Hafley said. Willis remains a low-end QB2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Shough playing through hand injury
items.desc: Saints QB Tyler Shough is reportedly playing through a hand injury.
items.impact: Saints head coach Kellen Moore was asked directly whether Shough's hand is broken. "It got banged two weeks ago and he's just wearing some protective layers there," he said. It doesn't appear Shough is in danger of missing any time, but he'll need to be monitored on the injury report this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cobie Durant (hamstring) works on rehab field during practice Monday
items.desc: Cobie Durant was working on the side field during practice on Monday.
items.impact: Durant remains week-to-week working his way back from a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) goes through individual drills Monday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown went through individual drills in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Overshown did the same in practice last Friday. He could have a chance at returning for Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (illness) practices Monday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was able to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Porter was ruled out late ahead of last Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. His presence in practice to start the week is a good sign for his status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Guyton (back) at practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Guyton took part in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Guyton suffered a back injury in last Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. He was reported to not be dealing with a serious injury.
